listing.name: Immercenary — pc-immercenary (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. City/shots/death/debrief/secondjump claimed, not fullcompletion; earlier customengine route superseded. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA 3DO Immercenary IMG, including the disc programs and OS files. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own IMG with operafs.py, generate static ARM code with 3dokit staticemit and build with CMake. Start pfboot --boot --window. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports the city, shooting, death, debrief and second jump. Full completion has not been established. This replaces the earlier custom-engine procedure. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
